scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
You're an adventurer of this world... {0}, right? So, what can an old person like me do for you?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
您是这个世界的冒险者...{0}，对吧？那么，像我这样的老人能为您做些什么呢？

scripts.text: I would like a tarot card reading.
scripts.translation: 我想看一次塔罗牌占卜。

scripts.text: What's a tarot card reading?
scripts.translation: 什么是塔罗牌占卜？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Monster card reading uses the cards of familiar monsters around us to get advice about our future, love, and many other things. 
 A fortuneteller like me takes a question from a person and asks the card. The card answers and I tell the person.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
魔物牌占卜使用我们周围熟悉的魔物的卡牌，来预测我们的未来、爱情以及许多其他事情。
像我这样的占卜师会接受一个人的提问，然后询问卡牌。卡牌会给出答案，我再将其转述给那个人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You should not get more than one card reading a day, and don't get one often since the card can get angry or confused. 
 Also, it can have a bad influence on your life, too!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
一天之内不应进行超过一次占卜，也不应频繁占卜，因为卡牌可能会生气或感到困惑。
此外，它也可能对你的生活产生不良影响！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 And... one more thing. 
 A card reading is only a reading... No matter how extraordinary the result may be, don't get too caught up with it. Bear that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
还有...还有一件事。
占卜只是占卜...无论结果多么离奇，都不要过于执着。请牢记这一点。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
Is that so...?
Well, if you want a monster card reading, you must first show me your faith. Otherwise, the monster spirits will grow angry and place a curse on you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
是这样吗...？
那么，如果您想要进行魔物牌占卜，首先必须向我展示您的信任。否则，魔物精灵会发怒并诅咒您。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
So, would you like a monster card reading?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
那么，您想要进行魔物牌占卜吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: I would like to think it over once more.
scripts.translation: 我想再考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Ok then. Young adventurer, may luck be with you...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
好的。年轻的冒险者，愿好运与您同在...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
Then...
Please pay your fee with all of your sincerity.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
那么...
请怀着您全部的诚意支付费用。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
Ah...?!
You have angered the monster spirits!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
啊...？！
您惹怒了魔物精灵！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
There's no need to overdo it. Just give with all your heart... *Tsk tsk*
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不必过分。只要全心全意地给予即可... *啧 啧*

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
I accept your heart and your devotion with my gratitude. Thoughts are more important than the amount when paying a fortune teller.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
我感激地接受您的心意和奉献。向占卜师支付费用时，心意比金额更重要。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
Then, I will begin to tell the fortune of your wish. Concentrate on yourself...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
那么，我将开始解读您愿望的运势。请集中精神...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
...
Clear your mind...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
...
请清空您的思绪...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
...
Once you have emptied your mind, think of the thing you most wish to know.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
...
一旦您清空了思绪，请思考您最想知道的事情。

scripts.text: (I would like to know my love fortune.)
scripts.translation: (我想了解我的爱情运势。)

scripts.text: (How rich will I be?)
scripts.translation: (我会变得多富有？)

scripts.text: (I need advice about my future.)
scripts.translation: (我需要关于未来的建议。)

scripts.text: (Can I get a warning of any dangers awaiting?)
scripts.translation: (能否提前警示潜在的危险？)

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 I see it... I see a sign of love...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
我看到了...我看到了爱情的征兆...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You are afraid to show yourself working, to your loved one.. 
 But that is not love. Do not be afraid to show different sides of yourself to your loved one..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
您害怕在爱人面前展露工作时的自己...
但这并不是爱。请不要害怕向爱人展示您不同的一面...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Maybe you are using love as an excuse to work? The card is saying to try observing love from a different perspective.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
也许您是在用爱作为工作的借口？这张牌建议您尝试从不同的角度去观察爱。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 How about taking a break from love and giving yourself time to relax.. I agree with what the card is saying.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不妨暂时从爱中抽离，给自己一些时间放松一下...我同意这张牌的说法。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A shovel..?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
一把铲子..?

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Its pure eyes look at a loved one but cannot recognize them, the wings flutter towards the loved one, but it helplessly stays in one place, 
 it calls its loved one, but they cannot hear..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
它用纯净的目光注视着爱人，却无法认出对方；翅膀向着爱人扇动，却无助地停留在原地；
它呼唤着爱人，对方却听不见...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The passion of love like a raging wave... You can't even hide it. 
 With such passionate love, isn't there only one way..?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
如汹涌波涛般炽热的爱...您甚至无法将其隐藏。
如此热烈的爱，难道只有一种方式吗..?

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The card is telling me, 'Fly to your loved one as you were a butterfly and shoot at it as you were a star.' 
..even though it doesn't sound like something a moth would say.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这张牌告诉我：'像蝴蝶一样飞向爱人，像星星一样向它射击。'
...虽然这听起来不像是飞蛾会说的话。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Perhaps the person you believe to be a butterfly is actually a moth. This fortune is awaiting a prudent judgement.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
也许您认为的蝴蝶其实是飞蛾。这份运势正在等待审慎的判断。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The one you love will give you a kiss of death. 
 The irresistable kiss.. It is up to you to decide whether to avoid it or not.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
您爱的人将给予您死亡之吻。
那令人无法抗拒的吻...是否要避开它，由您决定。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You are looking at a wonderful person, but their eyes are fixed in darkness. 
 How about trying to grab their attention?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
您正注视着一位美好的人，但他们的目光却停留在黑暗中。
不妨试着吸引他们的注意？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Your love needs fresh blood. Healthy exercises and eating habits are necessary! 
 You must change your living pattern first.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
您的爱需要新鲜血液。健康的运动和饮食习惯是必要的！
您必须首先改变您的生活模式。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Don't you think you are infatuated by outer appearance and gambling with love? You might have to be more careful about it this time.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
您难道不觉得您是被外表迷惑，并在拿爱赌博吗？这次您可能需要更加小心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 No matter how romantic and beautiful love is, it is not rightful, it is undesirable.. 
 is what this card means.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
无论爱多么浪漫美丽，它都不正当，也不被期望...
这就是这张牌的含义。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 In the rough sea called the world, only pirates, the outlaws of love, are the law. 
 This card supports strong love.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
在被称为世界的汹涌大海上，只有海盗，这些爱的法外之徒，才是法则。
这张牌支持强烈的爱。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It is a warning not to get involved in false love like pirated editions! 
 You may have to reconsider your love right now.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这是一个警告，不要陷入像盗版版一样虚假的爱！
您现在可能需要重新审视您的爱。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 This is praising the type of love that is always there, yet barely has a form as it does not exist. 
 Are you involved this type of love?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这是在赞美那种始终存在，却因不存在而几乎无形的那种爱。
您是否陷入了这种爱？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You must be careful. Love is quietly approaching and spreading poison. Be careful of the poison of love.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
您必须小心。爱正在悄悄接近并散布毒素。请小心爱的毒素。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Aren't you already caught in love that you cannot run away from? Look around you. 
 You might be captured inside invisible walls.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
您难道不是已经陷入了无法逃离的爱中吗？看看您周围。
您可能被困在无形的墙壁里。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 This fortune is saying that love is.. approaching wobbly and softly~ and then bam~ embracing it. 
 Very romantic. Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这张牌预示着，爱正摇摇晃晃、软绵绵地靠近，然后“啪”地一下，紧紧拥抱住你。
非常浪漫呢。呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 This card is warning you to not treat your loved one like a puppet. 
 You're not doing this, are you?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这张牌警告你，不要把爱人当作提线木偶。
你并没有这样做吧？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Dolls understand a human's heart more than a human. Try treating your loved one as they were a doll.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
玩偶比人类更懂人心。试着像对待玩偶一样对待你的爱人吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 you are afraid to look into a doll's eyes, that is because there is a dark shadow covering your love. 
 Rid yourselves of that shadow. Then the doll will smile as well.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你不敢直视玩偶的眼睛，是因为有一片幽冥火球般的阴影笼罩着你的爱。
驱散那片阴影吧。那样玩偶也会对你微笑。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Dolls become accustomed to the owner the more they are handled. Give your doll more attention. 
 The doll is craving attention. A lot of attention.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
玩偶被把玩得越多，就越习惯它的主人。多给玩偶一些关注吧。
玩偶渴望关注。非常渴望。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Do you fear the snake hair of a Medusa? However, love cannot be achieved with fear. 
 You must move forward!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你害怕米杜沙的蛇发吗？然而，爱无法靠恐惧获得。
你必须向前迈进！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Warriors that hastily attacked the Medusa all failed, but the one hero that used a mirror succeeded. 
 You cannot succeed in love with brute force. You must use wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
那些鲁莽攻击米杜沙的战士都失败了，但那位用镜子的英雄成功了。
在爱中，蛮力无法让你成功。你必须运用智慧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Must you love the one that has hair of snakes? Reconsider this love and think about it earnestly.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你必须爱那个长着蛇发的人吗？重新审视这份爱，认真思考一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It is a hint saying that a strong hairstyle is the key to turning over the situation. Change your hairstyle!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这是一个暗示，强大的发型是扭转局面的关键。换个发型吧！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Love must have two things: great strength and the will to live. Have you thought about whether or not you can overcome this with your current self?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
爱需要两样东西：强大的力量和求生的意志。你有没有想过，以你现在的状态，能否克服这一切？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A scythe may seem burdensome but a strong Baphomet can freely use it. 
 It is the same concept. you are ready, any type of love is possible. There is no such thing as impossible.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
镰刀看似沉重，但强大的巴风特却能自如地挥舞它。
道理是一样的。只要你准备好了，任何类型的爱都有可能。没有什么是“不可能”的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 There are those who are born, destined to run into this wall, an obstacle. Your love seems to have reached that wall.. It must be hard.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
有些人天生注定要撞上这堵墙，这个障碍。你的爱似乎已经撞上了那堵墙...一定很痛苦吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 This Baphomet looks as it is having a hard time. The person must be exhausted even it may not seem so.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这只巴风特看起来过得很辛苦。那个人一定已经精疲力竭了，即使表面上看不出来。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Can't you hear the cry of the card? It is suffering. Love is like that..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你听不到卡牌的哀鸣吗？它正在受苦。爱就是这样的...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Your love right now is so bored that it is yawning. How about trying something fresh and new?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你现在的爱无聊得都要打哈欠了。要不要尝试一些新鲜有趣的事情？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Deep sleep brings happiness and dreams. I think what you need right now is sleep.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
深沉的睡眠带来幸福和梦境。我觉得你现在需要的是睡眠。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 I feel some sort of emptiness.. Maybe there is a gap in your love?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
我感觉到某种空虚...也许你的爱中存在裂痕？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Even a traditional beauty can seem cold to others. Try looking at your loved one from a different point of view.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
即使是传统的美人，在别人眼中也可能显得冷漠。试着换个角度看看你的爱人吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 They may seem dreary and ominous but their attire is spotless. They show devotion to the other. 
 Even though you are not satisfied with your love right now, take a look at their attire.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
他们看起来阴郁不祥，但他们的衣着却一尘不染。他们向对方展现了忠诚。
虽然你对现在的爱并不满意，但请看看他们的衣着。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 There is a person you must not deal with thoughtlessly nearby. Don't say or do anything carelessly. You must be careful when dealing with this person.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
附近有一个你不能轻率对待的人。不要随意说话或做事。与这个人打交道时，你必须小心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Even the wind blows and the trail of her clothes flutter, her posture never changes. Loving a person with that type of heart will bring goodwill and happiness.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
即使风吹动她的衣角，她的姿态也纹丝不动。爱上这样一颗心，会带来善意与幸福。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 That lightens and attacks with a pickaxe! You must aggressively move forward. What do you think? Your fortune is a good one.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
它轻快地挥舞着镐头发起攻击！你必须积极向前推进。你觉得呢？你的运势很好。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The card only shows gaunt bones, but notice how it has all the necessary tools?
 Even though your love right now may seem as there is nothing to it, it has everything you need.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这张牌上只画着嶙峋的骨骼，但请注意，它拥有所有必要的工具。
虽然你现在的爱看起来空无一物，但它其实拥有你需要的一切。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It has a lantern on its back and even in its hand.. it believes one light is insufficient. 
 you are only shining one type of light to your loved one, shining another might help.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
它背上背着灯笼，手里也拿着...它认为一盏灯的光亮是不够的。
你只向爱人投射了一种光芒，或许再投射另一种光芒会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You know the smile of Mona Lisa.. Perhaps the person you are looking at has the same expression?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你知道蒙娜丽莎的微笑吗...也许你注视的那个人，有着同样的表情？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A knight on a horse is a fantasy in every person's heart. Make it so that this fantasy becomes real.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
骑马的骑士是每个人心中的幻想。让这份幻想成为现实吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Is that soldier waiting to attack? I can feel great tension between the horse and knight. 
 Don't run forward carelessly. Raise your sword and wait for your chance.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
那个士兵是在等待进攻吗？我能感觉到马和骑士之间强烈的紧张感。
不要鲁莽地向前冲。举起你的剑，等待你的机会。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 He is falling asleep awaiting a battle. Is it because he is laid back, or simply pathetic? Depends on the situation I suppose. 
 But you've got to give him credit for his boldness.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
他在等待战斗时睡着了。是因为他性格随和，还是单纯因为软弱？这取决于具体情况吧。
但不得不承认，他的胆量值得称赞。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Very favorable. It's to a point that I can feel strong energy from the card. I will give some of this energy to you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
非常吉利。吉利的程度让我能感觉到牌上强烈的能量。我会把其中一些能量传给你。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 What does the god of death have to say about love? It is something ominous for sure.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
死神对爱情有什么看法呢？这肯定是不祥之兆。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Hmm. How about giving a cute puppy as a gift? One with a round nose. Then they will surely be happy.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
嗯。送一只可爱的小狗作为礼物怎么样？鼻子圆圆的那种。那样他们一定会很开心的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 I can tell what it was doing from the way it is crying while holding an axe with blood. It is deeply wounded by love.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
从它哭着握着沾血斧头的样子，我能看出它之前在做什么。它被爱深深伤害了。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The pattern of the clothes symbolizes a warning. It is saying to be careful of love.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
衣服上的图案象征着警告。它在提醒你小心爱情。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 He is a warning you not to drool over someone else.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
他在警告你不要对别人垂涎三尺。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Who is he so fiercly gazing at with those grand muscles? He is looking at someone else for sure.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
他正用那发达的肌肉凶狠地盯着谁？他肯定是在看别人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Strengthen your body and observe the target. That is the step to success.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
强健你的身体，观察你的目标。这是通往成功的步骤。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 His navel is very pretty. You have to meet someone with that type of navel to be happy.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
他的肚脐很漂亮。你必须遇到一个拥有那样肚脐的人，才能幸福。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You'll get hurt you mess around. This card is giving you a piece of advice.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你胡闹的话会受伤的。这张牌正在给你一条建议。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 From the way he is massaging its back because of a shoulder cramp, maybe your love is seeking someone to massage them. Love starts from little thoughts.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
看他因为肩颈僵硬而按摩背部的样子，也许你的爱人正在寻找一个能给他们按摩的人。爱始于细微的念头。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 His expression is in awe. When encountering an absurd incident, his face and expression becomes peculiarly distorted. 
 I think the one you are looking towards has that type of expression.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
他的表情充满了敬畏。当遇到荒谬的事情时，他的脸和表情会变得奇怪地扭曲。
我想你注视的那个人，有着那样的表情。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A person's heart is like this card. you flip it over nobody can tell what is behind it. Try turning the person's card over.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
人的心就像这张牌。翻过来之后，没人能知道背面是什么。试着翻开那个人的牌吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jokers are sly, but that is just because it is their habit. 
 The reason the person may seem capricious or cunning is partially because they are born like that.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
裘卡很狡猾，但这只是它们的习性。
那个人看起来任性或狡诈，部分原因是他们天生如此。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The joker can't use any of his strength because he is tied to a card. Perhaps the person is caught in something and can't show their true merit?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
裘卡被绑在牌上，无法发挥任何力量。也许那个人被某事束缚住了，无法展现真正的才能？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Don't get fooled by tricks. They are a person, too. They know how to lie once in a while. Search for the trick calmly and carefully.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
别被特里克骗了。他们也是人，偶尔也会撒谎。请冷静且仔细地寻找真相。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It is saying that daring action is necessary, such as that of the Hode that strikes up from the sand.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
它说需要大胆的行动，就像蚯蚓从沙土中突然窜出那样。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Seeing that the Hode spits out sand to those who bother them, you must have done something to bother the person somehow.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
看到蚯蚓向打扰它们的人喷沙，你一定在某种程度上打扰到那个人了。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Hode has a very strong will to live. It is to survive in the forest. It is suggesting dating with that kind of will.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
蚯蚓有着极强的生存意志。为了在普勒斯特生存。它暗示着要以那样的意志去恋爱。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Ah.. there is a noble person up north. North it is. This direction will never change.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
啊...北方有一位高贵的人。就是北方。这个方向永远不会改变。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A walking bull is rare. The person you are looking towards is that rare. Don't let go of them. You may never see them again..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
行走的公牛很罕见。你注视的那个人也是如此罕见。别放手。你可能再也见不到他们了...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Can you see the strong muscles that even arrows cannot pierce? The person is like that, too.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你能看到连箭都无法刺穿的强壮肌肉吗？那个人也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The scariest thing is not the hammer nor horn. It is the massive legs that support its heavy weight. Nobody can survive a hit by those legs. The person is also probably hiding the most dangerous part.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
最可怕的不是锤子或锹形虫。而是支撑其沉重身躯的巨大双腿。没有人能在那双腿的打击下幸存。那个人可能也隐藏着最危险的部分。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 No matter how fearful the bull may be, it has a nose ring, it has already been tamed by humans. No matter how astonishing that person may be, taming is your responsibility.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
无论公牛多么可怕，它戴着牛鼻环，已经被人类驯服了。无论那个人多么惊人，驯服他们是你的责任。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The teeth of dustiness are very strong. This means.. use your teeth for victory?!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
猎蝇的牙齿非常锋利。这意味着...用牙齿去争取胜利？！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Become a pirate of love! It is a simple, yet strong fortune!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
成为爱情的海盗吧！这是一个简单却强大的预言！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 the lover does something wrong he pokes them with a needle. How scary..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
当爱人做错事时，就用针戳他们。真可怕...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 So do not worry and move on.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
所以不要忧心，继续前进吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Shoveling requires skills as well.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
铲土也需要技巧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Love is not meant to be so hard.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
爱情本不该如此艰难。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Strange that this would come up about love.. bizarre.. You aren't using this shovel to take revenge on someone, are you?? 
 Don't get malicious thoughts. Keep a kind heart.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
奇怪，关于爱情怎么会抽出这张牌...真古怪...你不会想用这把铲子去报复某人吧？
不要有恶意。保持宅心仁厚。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 How about taking a break from love and giving yourself time to relax.. I agree with this card.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不妨暂时放下爱情，给自己一点时间放松一下。我同意这张牌的说法。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 What a sad fortune.. 
 Indeed, it is sad love... it might be hard to overcome.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
真是不幸的运势...
确实，这是一段悲伤的爱情...想要克服它可能很难。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Passionate love is nearby. It is a good sign.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
炽热的爱情就在附近。这是个好兆头。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The passion of love like a raging wave.. You can't even hide it.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
如汹涌波涛般的爱情激情...你甚至无法将其隐藏。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Love is indeed a subject to be dealt with prudence. Keep that in mind young one.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
爱情确实是需要谨慎对待的话题。年轻人，请记住这一点。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Charisma... is the sweetest poison.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
魅力...是最甜蜜的毒药。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 so, you need to try something other than charisma.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
所以，你需要尝试除了魅力以外的其他方法。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Health is the best.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
健康才是最重要的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Beauty is only skin deep.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
美貌只是皮相。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 I hope you are not disappointed by the moral of this fortune.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
希望你不会因为这个运势的寓意而感到失望。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You must overcome it - no matter how strong the wave is.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你必须克服它——无论这股浪潮有多强烈。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Illegal copying is not love!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
非法复制不是爱！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Love's form is obscure.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
爱情的形态是晦涩难懂的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 There is no cure for this poison!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这种毒药无药可解！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You have been blinded by love and became a prisoner! Shouldn't you escape?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你被爱情蒙蔽了双眼，成为了囚徒！难道你不应该逃离吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Romance is the best part of love~
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
浪漫是爱情中最美好的部分~

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Love is not supposed to be about controlling and restraining~ mm~
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
爱情不应该关于控制和束缚~嗯~

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Your loved one can't be worse than a doll, can they?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你的爱人不会比玩偶更糟糕吧？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 That is what love is.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这就是爱情。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Delicate treatment and attention is the best in love.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
在爱情中，细致的呵护与关注是最好的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Love must be pushed forward!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
爱情需要主动推进！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Do you understand what I mean young one?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
年轻人，你明白我的意思吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 What do you think? Isn't this a great opportunity to ponder about the relationship.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你觉得呢？这不是一个反思你们关系的绝佳机会吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Fashion is in the hands of those who are ahead!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
时尚掌握在那些走在前面的人手中！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Know love and know thyself!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
了解爱情，也了解你自己！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Love requires preparation as well!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
爱情也需要准备！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Know love and know thyself!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
了解爱情，也了解你自己！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 What a pity.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
真可惜。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Approach then with affection.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
那就带着爱意去接近吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 So don't be upset about it!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
所以不要为此难过！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Try changing your dating style.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
试着改变一下你的约会方式。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Get some sleep.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
去睡一觉吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Take a close look.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
仔细看一看。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Look at love from a different perspective. You never know when you'll be able to discover something.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
换个角度看待爱情。你永远不知道何时会发现些什么。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 it is carefully worn, their heart for you can be seen in it as well..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
它被精心佩戴着，从中也能看出对方对你的心意...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Bear that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
请记住这一点。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Keep a righteous heart and mind.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
保持正直的心与念。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Is your heart ready young one?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
年轻人，你的心准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Don't get too greedy about things.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不要太贪心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 They might be feeling that one is not enough.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
也许他们觉得一个还不够。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Don't try to gaze straight them. Make an effort to approach them.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不要直视对方。试着主动去接近他们。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Then there will surely be progress.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
那么一定会取得进展的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 This means now is a time to wait. How about it, would you like to wait a while?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这意味着现在是等待的时候。怎么样，你想稍等一会儿吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 How about becoming a brave warrior in the battle of love?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
在爱情的战场上，你愿意成为一名勇敢的战士吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Devote that energy to love..!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
把那份精力都奉献给爱情吧！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 I think it is trying to give a warning. Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
我觉得这是在发出警告。请小心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 But can't help it they don't like puppies.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不过没办法，他们就是不喜欢小狗。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 that wound isn't cured soon, it will become as Anubis wanted.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
如果那个伤口不能很快愈合，就会变成安毕斯想要的样子。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
Be cautious.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
请保持警惕。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 That's bad! You will be punished!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这很糟糕！你会受到惩罚的！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Don't get sidetracked and look elsewhere! You will be cursed!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不要分心去看别的地方！否则你会被诅咒的！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 you want love as well, why don't you take the card's advice and prepare yourself first?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你也想要爱情，为什么不听从卡牌的建议，先做好准备呢？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Ok? Keep that in mind~
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
好吗？记住这一点~

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You did something wrong to your loved one, didn't you? Make an effort to make up for it~!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你是不是对心爱的人做了错事？努力弥补一下吧~！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Next time you meet them, give them a massage. Start with the little things.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
下次见到他们时，给他们做个按摩。从这些小事开始做起。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Did you do something absurd to that person? Are you sure? Think about it~
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你是不是对那个人做了荒唐的事？你确定吗？好好想想~

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You must approach their true heart. Understand?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你必须接近他们的真心。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Will you be able to approach them regardless? To do so, you must prepare you heart.. mm..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
无论如何，你都能接近他们吗？要做到这一点，你必须准备好自己的心...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 you love them, free them from the chains tying them down.. That is consideration.. and love
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
既然你爱他们，就解开束缚他们的锁链吧...这就是体贴...也是爱。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 And then search for a different route. That is the wise decision.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
然后寻找另一条路。这才是明智的决定。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Maybe you are discouraged a little too much right now. Be brave and daring young one.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
也许你现在有些过于沮丧了。勇敢大胆一点吧，年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Maybe you are being troublesome? Make an effort to relax a little more.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
也许是你太拘谨了？试着再放松一点吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Hmm, try love with more spirit. You will get good results.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
嗯，试着用更热情的爱去对待吧。这样会有好结果的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Trust me and go for it.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
相信我，放手去做吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The card is saying this.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
牌面显示的是这个意思。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 To attack with love.. you will need a stronger attack.. Mmm..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
用爱去进攻...你需要更强大的攻势...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You must love but be careful at the same time. You never know when you will be hit by the hind legs.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你必须去爱，但同时也要小心。你永远不知道什么时候会被踢到。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Approach them with more sincerity and consideration.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
用更真诚和体贴的态度去接近他们。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You seeked advice about love. 
 Even if you may not pleased with it, consider it calmly and make an effort to find true happiness.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你寻求了关于爱情的建议。
即使你可能对此不满意，也请冷静地思考，并努力寻找真正的幸福。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Then...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
那么...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Ooh... something about your fortune is starting to show...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
噢...关于你的运势，似乎开始显现了...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You must work hard to become wealthy. Don't think of other things.. Focus on and put effort into achieving your goals.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你必须努力工作才能变得富有。不要想其他事情...专注于并努力达成你的目标。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Something very rare may come your way. A gold mine has been the dream of many since ancient times. You have a gold mine right in front of you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
非常稀有的事情可能会降临到你身上。金矿自古以来就是许多人的梦想。你面前就有一座金矿。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 In the stomach pocket, there must be a secret treasure. There may be something in your pocket as well.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
在腹部的口袋里，一定藏着秘密的宝藏。你的口袋里可能也有什么东西。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The card says that you should not be too greedy, for that may cause you to dig your own grave.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
牌面显示你不应该太贪婪，否则可能会自掘坟墓。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Did you know that a moth's wings has infinite amounts of powder on it? A moth symbolizes wealth in the sense that it can gather wealth just as the powder on its wings.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你知道吗，飞蛾的翅膀上有无限多的粉末？飞蛾象征着财富，就像它翅膀上的粉末一样，能够聚集财富。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You must work hard to become wealthy. Don't think of other things. Simply focusing on your goals putting effort into it will help.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你必须努力工作才能变得富有。不要想其他事情。只要专注于目标并付出努力，就会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 There is a common saying that when a moth flaps its wings, wealth will fly away as well. It's not a very good sign.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
有一句俗语说，当飞蛾扇动翅膀时，财富也会随之飞走。这不是一个好兆头。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Dustiness teeth are very strong. This means..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
猎蝇的牙齿非常锋利。这意味着...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 When a dustiness flies around, a big expense comes up. You may need to spend some money soon.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
当猎蝇飞来飞去时，就会有一笔大开销。你最近可能需要花点钱。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Dracula brings in money. Maybe it is the moral influence from when it was a count. It is expensive to be a vampire, but I've never seen a poor one before.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
德古拉会带来金钱。也许是因为它生前是伯爵的道德影响。做吸血鬼很昂贵，但我从未见过贫穷的吸血鬼。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 To Dracula, money is not important. Blood is more valuable. To you, money must not be that important. You don't need to be concerned about money.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
对于德古拉来说，金钱并不重要，血液才更有价值。对你而言，金钱想必也不是那么重要。你不必为金钱担忧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Dracula mocks human's money. To him it is worthless.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
德古拉嘲笑人类的金钱。对他来说，那毫无价值。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 No matter what, stealing is wrong! Even a Drake blesses you in the name of pirates! Stealing is forbidden!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
无论如何，偷窃都是错误的！即使是海盗之王也会以海盗之名诅咒你！偷窃是被禁止的！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You will gather good fortune in a secretive and peculiar way.. Although, there seems to be shadows over some parts of your life.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你会以一种隐秘而奇特的方式获得好运。不过，你生活中的某些部分似乎笼罩着阴影。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The reason pirates indulge in others assets in the vast rough ocean, is because it is the only way to let the people of the land know of their existence.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
海盗在广阔汹涌的大海上掠夺他人财产，是因为这是让陆地上的人知晓他们存在的唯一方式。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Marina prefers clean funds. It hates suspicious money. Your possessions should be clean as well.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
玛丽娜偏好干净的财源。它讨厌来路不明的金钱。你的财产也应该是干净的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marina gathers money quietly, little by little, and freely roaming at the same time. That's the real way to make money. The Marina is suggesting this method to you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
玛丽娜静静地、一点一点地积累金钱，同时自由自在地漫游。这才是真正的赚钱之道。玛丽娜正在向你推荐这种方法。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marina is not interested in money. The card suggests that you will resemble these traits as well. You will enjoy life apart from money.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
玛丽娜对金钱不感兴趣。这张卡牌暗示你也会具备这种特质。你将享受远离金钱的生活。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You will gather money swiftly and quietly, then boom~ blow it all at once.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你会迅速而安静地积攒金钱，然后“轰”的一声，一次性花光。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marionette treasures art over wealth. Bear that in mind. Honor over assets.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傀儡娃娃珍视艺术胜过财富。请记住这一点。荣誉高于资产。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marionette likes shiny money. Not dull money, but the shiny kind.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傀儡娃娃喜欢闪闪发光的金钱。不是暗淡无光的，而是那种闪闪发光的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marionette requires lots of money. Its expenditures are enormous. You must have many expenditures ahead of you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傀儡娃娃需要大量的金钱。它的开销巨大。你面前想必也有许多开销。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marionette uses a lot of money. There is someone around you that is like that, too.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傀儡娃娃花钱如流水。你身边也有这样的人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The hair of the Medusa symbolizes the amount of wealth. Seems as something good will happen to you, young one.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
米杜沙的头发象征着财富的数量。看来会有好事发生在你身上，年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The hair of the Medusa are all snakes. Snakes symbolize greed and slyness. When gathering things, it seems as a cunning force will join you. It's not exactly a bright sign..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
米杜沙的头发全是蛇。蛇象征着贪婪和狡猾。在获取财富时，似乎有一股狡猾的力量会加入你。这并不完全是个吉兆...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Medusa is strongly recommending saving. This card is telling you to save. It says to put many savings accounts in your hair and make yourself resemble its head shape.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
米杜沙强烈建议储蓄。这张卡牌在告诉你去存钱。它说要在头发里存很多储蓄账户，让自己看起来像它的头型。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Medusa does not enjoy playing with money. you are attempting to use money other than the way it should be used, you should stop. Why?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
米杜沙不喜欢玩弄金钱。如果你试图以不当的方式使用金钱，你应该停止。为什么？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The great strength of the Baphomet brings in fortune. It seems as you will be able to gather much wealth with the aid of the Baphomet's force!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
巴风特的强大力量会带来财运。看来在巴风特力量的帮助下，你将能积累大量财富！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The scythe of the Baphomet means a strong tool to gather wealth. you have a strong tool like his, it should be easy to gather wealth.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
巴风特的镰刀意味着强大的敛财工具。如果你拥有像他那样强大的工具，积累财富应该很容易。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Baphomet would like a tribute. He is saying that you do, he will return great benefits.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
巴风特想要一份贡品。他说如果你献上贡品，他将回报巨大的利益。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Sandman cries with sadness when money comes up. It is sad because money does not possess love or affection.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
泥人因为提到金钱而悲伤地哭泣。它感到难过，因为金钱没有爱或情感。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Sandman is screaming because it saw too much money. It saw the money in the hands of your future. I wonder what all that money is?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
泥人尖叫着，因为它看到了太多的钱。它看到了你未来手中的金钱。我想知道那都是些什么钱？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Sandman's body is empty inside. Your wallet seems to be emtpy, too. You should save up some money.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
泥人的身体内部是空的。你的钱包似乎也是空的。你应该存点钱。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Money is like sand. Even you save it, once the wind blows, it disappears. This card shows the emptiness of money.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
金钱就像沙子。即使你存下了它，一旦风吹来，它就会消失。这张卡牌展示了金钱的空虚。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Sohee is wearing a fine article. To wear something like that, you would need plenty of money. Do you know what the secret is? Sohee saved very much when she was once alive.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
鬼女穿着精美的衣物。要穿那样的衣服，你需要很多钱。你知道秘诀吗？鬼女生前存了很多钱。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Sohee hates misers. She believes she has become like that because of a miser. Don't be stingy in front of Sohee!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
鬼女讨厌吝啬鬼。她认为自己是变成这样是因为一个吝啬鬼。不要在鬼女面前吝啬！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Sohee dislikes the wealthy. They try to gather money, but never use it for others. you don't want to be cursed by Sohee, you need to learn how to be generous with money.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
鬼女不喜欢富人。他们试图积攒金钱，但从不为别人使用。如果你不想被鬼女诅咒，你需要学会如何慷慨地使用金钱。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Sohee likes foreign money. They are cute and pretty. you have foreign currency, Sohee will love you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
鬼女喜欢外币。它们可爱又漂亮。如果你有外币，鬼女会喜欢你。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Those who work hard will gather great fortune. The Skeleton says diligent work will help greatly in gathering wealth.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
努力工作的人会积累巨大的财富。邪骸战士说，勤奋的工作将极大地帮助积累财富。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Its youth is gone after a lifetime of chasing after gold. It became a monster with only bones left. No matter how much you like money and your work, look after your life as well.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
在追逐黄金的一生之后，它的青春已经逝去。它变成了一个只剩下骨头的魔物。无论多喜欢金钱和工作，也要照顾好你的生活。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 To become rich, you must work hard as you became a skeleton. The Skeleton is saying to work hard until you become a skeleton.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
要致富，你必须像变成邪骸战士那样努力工作。邪骸战士说，要努力工作直到变成骷髅。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Skeleton says that you can make money by going north. Go north.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
邪骸战士说，你可以向北走赚钱。向北走。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A knight is a job that requires a lot of money. A hint of a big expense. You might want to tighten your belt.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
骑士是一个需要很多钱的职业。这是一个大额支出的暗示。你可能需要勒紧裤腰带。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Knights do not fight for money. they did, they would be a mercenary. A knight reaches for something higher. What the knight wants to tell you is the way to live.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
骑士不为金钱而战。如果他们这样做，他们就是佣兵。骑士追求更高的目标。骑士想告诉你的是生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A knight values honor more than fortune. They consider discussing wealth itself dirty not worthy. How would you be able to ask such a knight a fortune about wealth?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
骑士重视荣誉胜过财富。他们认为讨论财富本身是肮脏和不值得的。你如何能向这样的骑士询问关于财富的运势？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You need to think of an ideal more noble than money. The fortune the knight suggests is this: Knights never speak of ways to make money.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你需要思考比金钱更崇高的理想。骑士建议的运势是：骑士从不谈论赚钱的方法。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Working hard is the only way to gather wealth; don't get sidetracked and put effort into working will help your fortune.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
努力工作是积累财富的唯一途径；不要分心，将精力投入到工作中将有助于你的运势。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 What does the god of death have to say about wealth? It is surely a bad omen. It is trying to warn something.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
死神之神对财富有什么看法？这肯定是个坏兆头。它试图警告某事。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Anubis is very interested in the sacrifices offered. The offerings he likes are youth and effort.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
安毕斯对献上的祭品非常感兴趣。他喜欢的祭品是青春和努力。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Anubis is giving a warning of the west. There is a being there that can break away your wealth.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
安毕斯对西方发出警告。那里有一个存在可以夺走你的财富。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Anubis hates those who try to gather money for his death. He believes it's a waste of money. Don't make the mistake of gathering money for death.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
安毕斯憎恨那些试图为死亡敛财的人。他认为那是浪费金钱。不要犯下为死亡敛财的错误。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Orc Lord possesses much wealth. It's because of greed. Greed is essential in collecting money. The desire and greediness to make money is not something to be ashamed about. Be diligent and go make money.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
兽人酋长拥有巨额财富。这是因为贪婪。贪婪是敛财的关键。赚钱的欲望和贪婪并不可耻。请勤勉地去赚钱吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Orc Lord starts drooling about anything involving money. He targets anybody with money.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
兽人酋长一提到钱就流口水。他会盯上任何有钱的人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 There should be great wealth awaiting in the direction the Orc Lord's horn is pointing. The card is directing towards..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
在兽人酋长角所指的方向，应该正等待着巨大的财富。这张卡牌指向……

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Orc Lord likes gold. Of all the treasures, gold is the best. Closely watch gold.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
兽人酋长喜欢黄金。在所有宝物中，黄金是最好的。请密切关注黄金。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jack makes money through jokes. Others' happiness is the key to his wealth.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
杰克通过玩笑赚钱。他人的快乐是他财富的关键。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jack likes fun money. He detests sad and burdensome money. 
 He always says this. Light-hearted and easy money isn't dangerous even it piles up.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
杰克喜欢轻松的钱。他厌恶沉重且令人悲伤的钱。
他总是这么说。轻松愉快的钱即使堆积如山也不危险。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jack thinks of money as a foolish item. But somehow he makes that kind of money. 
 That's why those who are controlled by fools consider the other a fool, too.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
杰克把钱视为愚蠢的东西。但不知为何他能赚到那种钱。
这就是为什么被傻瓜控制的人，也会被视为傻瓜。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jack is asking for money. Don't be stingy about paying those who bring entertainment and fun.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
杰克正在索要钱财。对于带来娱乐和乐趣的人，请不要吝啬。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Do you know what a joker's specialty is? It is tricking others and making money. Be wary of the joker.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你知道裘卡的专长是什么吗？是欺骗他人并从中获利。请提防裘卡。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Joker says you let him borrow money, he will repay you with more. You're going to refuse, right? But the Joker's temptation does not end after one try. 
 He will linger around you as a neighbor, or a rare item and ask for money.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
裘卡说如果你借钱给他，他会还你更多。你肯定会拒绝，对吧？但裘卡的诱惑不会只尝试一次。
他会像邻居或稀有物品一样徘徊在你身边，并索要钱财。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Even a joker asks for change, never give any to him. He will ask for change, then end up ask for a big sum of money. 
 Jokers are like that. They have the ability to turn a small mistake into a big calamity.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
即使是裘卡找零，也千万不要给他。他会先找零，最后变成索要一大笔钱。
裘卡就是这样。他们有能力将小错误变成大灾难。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 There is only one reason a Joker requests money.. to take yours. 
 His goal is not to become rich. A real foul playful one.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
裘卡索要钱财只有一个原因……为了拿走你的钱。
他的目标不是变得富有。真是个狡猾的恶作剧者。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Hodes do not know about money. They just gobble everything up. But that might be the shortcut to gaining great wealth.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
蚯蚓不懂金钱。它们只是吞食一切。但这可能是获得巨大财富的捷径。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Hodes do not know anything about money. But they do not forgive those who have an eye on their things. 
 Not being greedy and taking care of your share is the wisest way to manage your wealth.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
蚯蚓对金钱一无所知。但它们不会原谅那些觊觎它们东西的人。
不贪婪并妥善保管自己的份额，是管理财富最明智的方式。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Hode knows nothing about money. But a very rare item drops from a Hode's body. 
 It has a treasure in it without knowing.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
蚯蚓不懂金钱。但从蚯蚓身上会掉落非常稀有的物品。
它在不知不觉中蕴含着宝物。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Hodes are strong even though they live in the desert. Just because the environment is poor, doesn't mean that you can't gather wealth.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
蚯蚓即使生活在沙漠中也很强壮。仅仅因为环境恶劣，并不意味着你不能积累财富。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Do you know the saying that says those who work like bulls become rich? Working hard is the best way.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你知道那句“像牛一样工作就能致富”的谚语吗？努力工作是最好的方法。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Bulls only know how to work, but the bull itself has a lot to offer. Meat, leather, horn..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
牛只知道工作，但牛本身能提供很多东西。肉、皮革、角……

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Bulls continue to work even on gloomy days. Then they can gather a lot of things.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
即使在阴郁的日子里，牛也会继续工作。这样它们就能积累很多东西。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Bulls do not like working for money. They are disgruntled when others consider labor as money. 
 Shouldn't you reconsider working against your will just for money?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
牛不喜欢为了金钱而工作。当别人把劳动视为金钱时，它们会感到不满。
你不该仅仅为了金钱，就违背自己的意愿去工作吗？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 How about getting involved in raising cattle? It seems like you can gather much wealth through it.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不如尝试养牛吧？看起来你可以通过它积累很多财富。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Then good luck and try your best.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
那么祝你好运，加油吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 All in all, a big fortune is right in front of your eyes. I'll be looking forward to it.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
总而言之，巨大的财富就在你眼前。我期待着你。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Are you hiding things from other people? You should get rid of them. They may bring bad luck.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你在向别人隐瞒什么吗？你应该把它们丢掉。它们可能会带来厄运。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You may not feel good about it, but you should accept the card's advice..!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你可能对此感到不舒服，但你应该接受卡片的建议！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Young one, you will gather much wealth.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
年轻人，你将积累很多财富。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Good luck and try your best.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
祝你好运，加油吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Be careful not to lose your assets. Take good care of your wallet.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
小心不要失去你的资产。好好保管你的钱包。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Your tooth will become a gold tooth?!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你的牙齿会变成金牙？！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You might want to set up a budget to prepare for this expense.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你可能需要制定一个预算，为这笔开销做准备。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You don't need to worry about money.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你不需要担心金钱。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 How about it? Try being a little more casual about money.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
怎么样？试着对金钱稍微随意一点。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You should not be so concerned about money and assets, too.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你不应该如此担心金钱和资产。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Noooooooo stealing!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
绝对不可以偷窃！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It's an uneasy fortune. Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这是一个不安的预言。你准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 But those who live on land do not need to do so. Don't look over other people's belongings. It is the advice of a pirate.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
但生活在陆地上的人不需要这样做。不要窥视别人的财物。这是海盗的建议。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Why? The Marina might get rid of it all.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
为什么？玛丽娜可能会把它们全部丢掉。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You should take a shot at it. You've got nothing to lose.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你应该尝试一下。你没有什么可失去的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 That's the fortune from a Marina card.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这是来自水母卡片的预言。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Very witty, hoho.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
真是机智，呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 What an important lesson.. Mmm...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
多么重要的一课啊...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Anyways, search for that type of money.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
总之，去寻找那种类型的金钱吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A gloomy fortune. How about being cautious?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这是一个阴沉的预言。不如小心谨慎些？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 There is a person like that for sure. You should watch out.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
肯定有那样的人存在。你应该提防一下。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You can look forward to it.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你可以期待一下。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 But you surely will get money. Hmm..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
但你肯定会赚到钱的。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 That is what it believes to be wealth. Oooh!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
那就是它认为的财富。噢噢！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Because there can be a curse of the Medusa.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
因为可能会遭遇米杜沙的诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It's a good sign! Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这是个好兆头！恭喜！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 What the Baphomet is trying to say is, find a mean that can help you like his tool.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
巴风特想要说的是，寻找一种能像它的工具那样帮助你的手段。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 So try offering a part of your assets to the Baphomet.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
所以试着献出你的一部分资产给巴风特吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 I wonder the meaning of money will slowly disappear from your life as well.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
金钱的意义也会慢慢从你的生活中消失吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 I wonder.. Aren't you curious?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
我很好奇...你不觉得好奇吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Sandman likes to save, too. Even a monster likes to save, but when a human doesn't...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
泥人也喜欢存钱。连魔物都喜欢存钱，但人类如果不存的话...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Indeed, money is futile.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
确实，金钱是徒劳的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 So you should start saving, too.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
所以你也应该开始存钱。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 That type of stinginess will spite other people. Use money when it is necessary.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
那种吝啬会得罪别人。在必要时使用金钱。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 So you have malicious desires, forget them. An ill heart easily gathers misfortune.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
所以你有恶意的欲望，忘掉它们吧。邪恶的心容易招致不幸。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Keep an eye out for foreign currency. It will bring you luck.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
留意一下外币。它会给你带来好运。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Hmm~ a ghost is saying strange things.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
嗯~幽灵在说奇怪的话。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 There is much more to life than wealth.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
生活中比财富更重要的东西还有很多。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Then not only the Skeleton, but many people will repay you greatly.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
那么不仅邪骸战士，许多人都会报答你的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 There must be great fortune in that direction.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
那个方向一定有大好的运气。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 That is, you don't want go to bankrupt.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
也就是说，你不想破产。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Set a goal higher than money and wealth. Do you understand, young one?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
设定比金钱和财富更高的目标。你明白了吗，年轻人？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The knight says that a new road of life will open once you look away from fortune.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
骑士说，一旦你不再盯着财富，人生的新道路就会打开。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Compared to life, they believe money is foolish. The knight would like to understand these ideas of life.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
与生命相比，他们认为金钱是愚蠢的。骑士想要理解这些关于生命的理念。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 So do your best.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
所以请加油。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Be careful. It is the word of the god of death.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
小心。这是死神的话。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 you offer these two things, the Anubis says he will bring you wealth.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
如果你献上这两样东西，安毕斯说他会给你带来财富。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 you want to protect your assets, beware of the west.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
如果你想保护你的资产，小心西方。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 This is the true advice of a Anubis.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这是安毕斯真正的建议。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 But, too much greed is forbidden.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
但是，过度的贪婪是被禁止的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Therefore, don't speak of money to the Orc Lord.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
因此，不要对兽人酋长谈论金钱。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Same goes for humans. Be wary of those who are avaricious like the Orc Lord.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
人类也是如此。要警惕像兽人酋长那样贪婪的人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The northwest? Would you like to try your luck in that direction?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
西北方？你想试试那个方向的运气吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Gold is rather peculiar compared to other assets.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
与其他资产相比，黄金相当特殊。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Why don't you learn how to make others happy? It should be of great help.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你为什么不学学如何让别人开心呢？那应该会有很大帮助。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 As Jack's advice says, stay closer to light money. It is safer and better.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
正如杰克的建议所说，保持与小额金钱的亲近。这样更安全，也更好。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 you don't want to be considered a fool by Jack, don't be controlled by money. 
 Or else, Jack will attack.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不想被杰克看作傻瓜，就不要被金钱所控制。
否则，杰克会发起攻击。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Then, Jack will reward you in return.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
那样，杰克就会反过来奖励你。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jokers do not exist in one form. They will aim for your money in several different ways.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
裘卡不会只以一种形式存在。它们会以各种不同方式瞄准你的钱财。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Act wisely! You'll be in trouble you are tricked easily!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
要明智行事！如果你轻易上当，就会陷入麻烦！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 That's why you should be more careful about it.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
因此，你应该更加小心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 But losing money isn't a joke now, is it? You should be careful.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
但现在，损失金钱可不是开玩笑的事，对吧？你应该小心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Don't focus too much on money. Just work at it. It's saying that it is the best method.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不要过于关注金钱。只管努力工作。据说这是最好的方法。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Indeed, the Hode is right. Do you understand as well?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
确实，蚯蚓说得对。你也明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Take a careful look around you. Treasures are hidden all over.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
仔细看看你周围。宝物就隐藏在各处。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Don't blame the environment. That excuse is only for whiners.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不要责怪环境。那种借口只适合爱抱怨的人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Just like a bull.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
就像公牛一样。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You, too, should look after yourself and not just work. You have many hidden values.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你也要照顾好自己，不能只埋头工作。你身上有很多隐藏的价值。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Don't be picky about the days you work. You will be able to make more money.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不要挑剔工作的日子。这样你会赚到更多的钱。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It is a serious problem. It is your life, so ponder about it young one.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这是个严肃的问题。这是你的人生，年轻人，好好思考一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Most people are curious about money. 
 It is a very humanly and common curiosity. Cards are very stingy about fortunes regarding wealth.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
大多数人对金钱感到好奇。
这是非常人性且普遍的好奇心。塔罗牌对于关于财富的运势非常吝啬。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Therefore, getting a fortune like this is considered being lucky. Use this fortune to prosper.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
因此，得到这样的运势被认为是幸运的。利用这个运势去繁荣吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Future... the card that sees the future is beginning to speak...... Prepare yourself...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
未来...那张预见未来的牌开始说话了......做好准备......

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Youth is not eternal. At one point when you wake up, you realize you are already a middle-aged worker. 
 Even reminiscing about the past over a cup of coffee can't bring back time.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
青春不是永恒的。总有一天当你醒来，会发现自已已经成了中年工人。
即使对着咖啡杯回忆过去，时光也无法倒流。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 This fortune is foreshadowing that you will become a strong and healthy worker in the future. 
 Not a normal worker, but one that has great strength and might..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这个运势预示着，你未来将成为一名强壮健康的工人。
不是普通的工人，而是拥有强大力量和威严的人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Smoking in a mine is an imprudent, life-threatening thing to do. You are wasting your precious life with that kind of behavior.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
在矿井里抽烟是不明智且危及生命的行为。你正在用这种行为浪费宝贵的生命。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You may be shoveling in the future. In a dark dark place, shoveling that requires great strength. You must be careful young one.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你未来可能会从事挖掘工作。在黑暗的地方，进行需要巨大体力的挖掘。年轻人，你要小心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The moth is used when it is a caterpillar and ignored after it becomes a moth, by humans. 
 Which is better?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
人类在它是狂暴绿棉虫时会利用它，变成飞蛾后却会忽视它。
哪个更好呢？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The moth flies around without worrying about the future. It is telling you to fly freely rather than getting anxious about the future..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
飞蛾四处飞舞，不为未来担忧。它在告诉你，与其焦虑未来，不如自由地飞翔。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Dustiness' teeth are very strong. This means...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
猎蝇的牙齿非常锋利。这意味着...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The moth says that this is not a time to think about wealth and prosperity. It says that someone important has appeared near you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
飞蛾说，现在不是思考财富和繁荣的时候。它说，你身边出现了一位重要的人物。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Dustiness symbolizes a hazy future. It is similar to your mind right now. It says it is obvious. 
 It says that there is no set path in the future. Isn't a relief in a way?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
猎蝇象征着朦胧的未来。这与你此刻的心境相似。它说这是显而易见的。
它说，未来没有既定的道路。从某种角度来说，这难道不是一种解脱吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Sometime in your future, a future like Dracula awaits you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
在你的未来某个时刻，德古拉般的命运在等着你。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 If the condition is just right, vampires can live forever. But, when that perfect condition is disrupted, they meet a tragic end.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
如果条件合适，吸血鬼可以永生。但当那个完美的条件被打破时，它们就会迎来悲惨的结局。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Dracula says to be true to the present. Indeed, thinking and being true to the present is much more important than trying to figure out your future.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
德古拉说要忠于当下。确实，思考和忠于当下，比试图看清未来重要得多。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Pirates do not have a future. That doesn't mean you do not have one. But.. you simply need to make more prudent decisions.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
海盗没有未来。这并不意味着你没有未来。但是...你只需要做出更明智的决定。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 In this world, being a pirate out in the rough seas is very dangerous. But, they do not regret their decisions.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
在这个世界上，在汹涌的大海上做海盗非常危险。但他们并不后悔自己的选择。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Pirates are remembered as pirates even after they pass away. A person's name is beyond the matter of life and death.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
海盗死后仍被铭记为海盗。一个人的名字超越了生死的界限。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marina does not think of its future.. But I can tell you one thing. Survival. The Marina only thinks about survival and life.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
玛丽娜不思考它的未来...但我可以告诉你一件事。生存。玛丽娜只关心生存和生活。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marina doesn't think of its future.. but I can tell you one thing. Freedom. The Marina swims freely.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
玛丽娜不思考它的未来...但我可以告诉你一件事。自由。玛丽娜自由地游动。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Leave your future to the Marina. The Marina treasures its precious ocean. The sea will be of great significance in your future, too.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
将你的未来交给玛丽娜吧。玛丽娜珍视它宝贵的海洋。大海在你的未来也将具有重要意义。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A Marionette is a Marionette forever. Its past and future never changes. Its present is its future. Don't you think it is rather sad?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傀儡娃娃永远是傀儡娃娃。它的过去和未来从未改变。它的现在就是它的未来。你不觉得这很悲哀吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A Marionette is restrained but it has hope that it will be freed one day.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傀儡娃娃虽然受到束缚，但它怀有终有一天获得自由的希望。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The eyes of a Marionette symbolize 'challenge.' Challenge will mean a lot in your future.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傀儡娃娃的眼睛象征着“挑战”。挑战在你的未来将意味着很多。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marionette believes the present is more important than the future. Basically, asking about the future is pointless.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傀儡娃娃认为现在比未来更重要。基本上，询问未来是没有意义的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Medusa symbolizes the absolute one who accepts everyone's challenge. Your future will be in a position that is challenged by many.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
米杜沙象征着接受所有人挑战的绝对存在。你的未来将处于被许多人挑战的位置。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Medusa symbolizes the absolute one who accepts everyone's challenge. Your future must be filled with challenges!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
米杜沙象征着接受所有人挑战的绝对存在。你的未来必将充满挑战！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Medusa says that there will be great chaos in the future. Chaos... I'm not sure what type of chaos it means, but it is definitely something that has never happened before.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
米杜沙说未来将会发生巨大的混沌。混沌...我不确定它指的是哪种混沌，但这绝对是前所未有的事情。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The hair of the Medusa are sticking up. It is nervous about the big change that is going to happen. A change that even makes the scary Medusa worried.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
米杜沙的头发竖了起来。它对于即将发生的大变化感到紧张。连可怕的米杜沙都感到担忧的变化。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Baphomet doesn't care about a human's future. They simply observe quietly. Hmm... It seems like it has nothing to say about your future as well...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
巴风特并不关心人类的未来。它只是静静地观察着。嗯...看来它对你的未来也无话可说...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The scythe the Baphomet is holding signifies the strong will to conquer the future. 
 What you need is not someone else's help or wisdom, but strong willpower.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
巴风特手持的镰刀象征着征服未来的坚强意志。
你所需要的不是他人的帮助或智慧，而是坚强的意志力。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Baphomet says that humans have no future. It says that their greed and selfishness shows no hope. 
 The future will only open to those that go beyond human's greed.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
巴风特说人类没有未来。它说人类的贪婪和自私毫无希望。
只有超越人类贪婪的人，未来才会向他们敞开。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Baphomet is facing the future. No matter how much effort you put in, without an eye that looks towards the future, it is pointless. 
 The Baphomet is telling you to look towards the future.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
巴风特正面向着未来。无论付出多少努力，如果没有看向未来的眼光，都是徒劳的。
巴风特在告诉你，要看向未来。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A sand's future is simply sand. Not a rock, nor mud. Some things just don't change young one.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
沙的未来依然是沙。不是岩石，也不是泥土。有些东西就是不会改变的，年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A sand dune changes its shape even after a day. The Sandman card is speaking of a future with many changes.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
沙丘即使过了一天也会改变形状。泥人卡片预示着这将是一个充满变化的未来。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You will have a son in the future. Hmm? What'd you say? No plans for a baby?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你未来会生一个儿子。嗯？你说什么？没有生宝宝的计划？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 There are rare and precious treasures in the sand. The Sandman says that in the vast sand of the world, a treasure, will be discovered. That treasure is you young one.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
沙中藏着稀有而珍贵的宝物。泥人说，在广阔的世界之沙中，将会发现宝物。那个宝物就是你，年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Do you know what a Sohee thinks the most pitiful thing is? The future. It is because she was not able to live her future. 
 That is why you cannot bring up the subject of future in front of Sohee. I'm very sorry I cannot help.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你知道鬼女认为最悲惨的是什么吗？是未来。因为她无法拥有自己的未来。
所以你不能在鬼女面前提起未来的话题。很抱歉，我无法帮你。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Even in darkness you will shine for your goal. 
 The Skeleton is encouraging you to not lose your light even in a life in dark and damp places.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
即使在黑暗中，你也会为了目标而闪耀。
邪骸战士鼓励你，即使在阴暗潮湿的生活中，也不要失去你的光芒。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The story I heard from the skeleton goes like this. I am the king of the future. What in the world is that supposed to mean?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
我从邪骸战士那里听到的故事是这样的。我是未来的国王。这到底是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 If you want to do something great in the future, you must express your thankfulness to the Skeleton. 
 Then the Skeleton will help you. How do you express your thankfulness?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
如果你想在未来成就一番伟业，必须向邪骸战士表达你的感激。
那样邪骸战士就会帮助你。你要如何表达感激呢？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Skeleton has the ability to dig where it feels the future, rather than looking into it. 
 It is digging in the east right now. How about it, won't you try going there?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
邪骸战士拥有挖掘它感知到未来之地的能力，而不是窥探未来。
它现在正在东方挖掘。怎么样，你愿意去那里试试吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A knight's future leads to death. An honorable death on the battlefield. 
 One cannot live as a knight without being proud of that type of future.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
骑士的未来通向死亡。在战场上光荣地牺牲。
如果不为这样的未来感到自豪，就无法作为骑士生存。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A knight commenting about a person's future is very rare. 
 It says nothing for you in particular. Nothing ominous.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
骑士很少会评论一个人的未来。
它对你特别没有什么要说的。没有什么不祥之兆。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A knight commenting about a person's future is very rare. 
 It says it will say one thing for you. Dark clouds can be seen beyond the clear skies.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
骑士很少会评论一个人的未来。
它说会对你说一句。晴朗的天空之外，可以看到乌云。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It is necessary to reflect upon the past and present in order to look into the future. This card says to look carefully into your past.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
为了展望未来，有必要反思过去和现在。这张卡片说，要仔细审视你的过去。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 What does the god of death want to say about the future? It is definitely an ominous sign.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
死神想要对未来说些什么？这绝对是一个不祥的征兆。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Anubis likes comedy despite people's expectations. It looks forward to comedy. Comedy must be important in the future.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
安毕斯喜欢喜剧，尽管人们对此感到意外。它期待喜剧。喜剧在未来一定很重要。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Anubis is the god of death, but it expresses more interest in the future than death.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
安毕斯是死神，但它对未来的兴趣似乎比对死亡更浓厚。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Anubis says it has no interest in you. It is a good sign.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
安毕斯说它对你不感兴趣。这是一个好兆头。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Orc Lord says that dairy farming will develop in the future. Why don't you invest in it as well?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
兽人酋长说，未来畜牧业将会发展。你何不也投资一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Orc Lord says you need great strength in the future. Strength that is three, four times greater than now.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
兽人酋长说，你未来需要强大的力量。是现在的三、四倍那么强大。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Orc Lord says that love for your companions will become great strength in the future. 
 Your strength is not enough.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
兽人酋长说，对同伴的爱在未来将成为巨大的力量。
你现在的力量还不够。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Orc Lord is expressing opposition in being too curious about the future. 
 Pay a little more attention to the present.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
兽人酋长表示反对对未来说得太多。
请多关注当下。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jack says something interesting will happen in the future. According to him, the future will be more fun than the present.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
杰克说未来会发生有趣的事情。据他说，未来会比现在更有趣。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jack says, in order to prepare for the future, a delightful preparation is necessary. 
 Delightful preparation? I don't understand.. I suppose I am too old. Maybe young ones get it..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
杰克说，为了准备未来，需要令人愉快的准备。
令人愉快的准备？我不太明白...我想我可能太老了。也许年轻人能懂吧...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jack is jealous because a splendid person is headed your way in the future. 
 I wonder what type of person it is to make that Jack jealous!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
杰克嫉妒了，因为未来有一个出色的人正朝你走来。
我想知道是什么样的人能让杰克嫉妒！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jack says you may be frustrated in the future. 
 He says to overcome the frustration, it is necessary to think of happy thoughts.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
杰克说你未来可能会感到沮丧。
他说要克服沮丧，需要多想想开心的事。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Joker is trying to trick you. This card has all different types of ominous fortunes. 
 He wants to enjoy watching you tremble with anxiety.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
裘卡正在试图捉弄你。这张牌上全是各种不祥的预言。
他想享受看你因焦虑而颤抖的样子。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Jokers don't just appear and go away. They come back in the future. 
 They will seduce you numerous times.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
裘卡不会只出现一次就消失。它们会在未来再次出现。
它们会多次诱惑你。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Do you see the thing that looks like a leaf flying around the Joker? That is the spade mark. 
 Spades means death. Jokers leave those kinds of marks on purpose.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你看到那个像叶子一样在裘卡周围飞舞的东西了吗？那是黑桃标记。
黑桃意味着死亡。裘卡故意留下这种标记。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Joker offers a nice insurance and says to prepare for the future, but most of it is a waste of time.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
裘卡提供了一份不错的保险，并说要为未来做准备，但大部分时间都是浪费。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Hodes do not know about tomorrow. But though they are quiet, they endanger other living things. 
 Effort into oneself puts great power into the mere existence of one.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
蚯蚓不知道明天。但它们虽然安静，却会危害其他生物。
努力提升自己，能让你的存在拥有巨大的力量。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Hodes do not know about tomorrow, but they still know about death. 
 Even though you may be honest and simple, in a time of a crisis, you must be alert.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
蚯蚓不知道明天，但它们知道死亡。
即使你诚实单纯，在危机时刻，你也必须保持警惕。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Hodes are afraid of crises. You should try not to be afraid of crises either.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
蚯蚓害怕危机。你也应该试着不要害怕危机。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Before, bulls used to be thought of as foolishly honest workers, but these days bulls are great strong fighters.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
以前，牛被认为是愚蠢诚实的工人，但现在牛是强大的格斗家。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Do bulls leave leather when they pass away? Or was it the tiger? 
 Anyways, he is jealous of the humans that leave their name in history.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
牛死后会留下皮革吗？还是说那是老虎？
总之，它嫉妒那些能在历史上留下名字的人类。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It might seem funny that a bull will look into the future, but the bull is looking into your future right now. 
 He says your future is mixed with storms and fall weather.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
一头牛窥探未来，听起来可能有点滑稽，但它现在正在窥探你的未来。
它说你的未来充满了风暴和萧瑟的秋意。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The bull thinks of the happiness awaiting in the future, but it doesn't like reduced efficiency because of that happiness.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
牛想着未来等待着的幸福，但它不喜欢因为这份幸福而降低效率。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Treasure the present.. is what the card is saying.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这张牌的意思是：珍惜当下。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You should prepare for your future.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你应该为未来做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Act with a little more wisdom for your future.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
为了你的未来，行动时请多一分智慧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 This type of fortune is never wrong.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这种类型的运势从不会出错。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Check to see if there is an aspect of your life that is like the moth.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
检查一下，看看你生活中是否有像飞蛾一样的方面。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 This is the fortune from this card.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这就是这张牌所显示的运势。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 To live the future with strong teeth?!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
用强健的牙齿去咀嚼未来？！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Any ideas who that may be?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你知道那可能指的是谁吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It is not good nor bad, so there is always room for new possibilities.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这既不好也不坏，所以总有新的可能性存在。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 If you hope for that type of future, it is no problem, but you should be careful nonetheless.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
如果你希望拥有那样的未来，那没问题，但即便如此你也应该小心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 This means that if you go after fame and eternal life, tragedy awaits you in the end. They are not the important things in life.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这意味着如果你追求名声和永生，悲剧最终会等着你。它们并不是生命中最重要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Unfortunately, I agree with it young one.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不幸的是，年轻人，我同意这个观点。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 How about changing your lifestyle? That's what this means.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不如改变一下你的生活方式？这就是它的意思。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Because they find their meaning of life in the process. Young one, how about searching for the meaning of your life?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
因为它们在过程中找到了生命的意义。年轻人，不如也去寻找一下你生命的意义？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You should live with that aspect in mind.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你应该带着这种心态去生活。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You.. no, all of us should learn and do the same.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你...不，我们所有人都应该学习并做到这一点。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 How about living like that, too?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不如也试着那样生活？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A fisherman? Oceanographer? Pirate? Although I do not know which job it is...
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
渔夫？海洋学家？海盗？虽然我不知道具体是哪一种职业...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 But that could also be a good thing. This is the meaning of a Marionette.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
但这也许也是一件好事。这就是傀儡娃娃的含义。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Very nice. This fortune signifies 'hope'.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
非常好。这个占卜象征着“希望”。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 ...to the point where that challenge will change your life.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
...直到那次挑战改变了你的人生。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The Marionette devotes everything into the present. It suggests that type of attitude to you, too.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
傀儡娃娃将一切奉献给当下。它也建议你采取这种态度。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It could be good and bad. It is also a very tiring position.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这有好有坏。这也是一种非常疲惫的状态。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Always challenge others! It is alright to fail, since challenge itself will become life.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
永远去挑战他人！失败也没关系，因为挑战本身就会成为生命。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 There is something that you must fight.. and win, in your future.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
在你的未来，有一件事是你必须战斗...并获胜的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 How about preparing yourself as well?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不如也试着做好准备？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It has an unconcerned expression.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
它带着一种毫不在意的表情。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Once you have that type of willpower, the road to the future will be very broad and promising.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
一旦你拥有了这种意志力，通往未来的道路将会非常宽广且充满希望。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The card expects something like that from you.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这张卡片期待你做到那样。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 To know your position right now and where to aim in the future.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
了解你现在的处境，以及未来要瞄准的方向。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 What the Sandman card is trying to say is to treasure your present self.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
泥人卡片想要表达的是，要珍惜现在的自己。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It says not to be too caught up with the present, because the future is always changing.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
它说不要过于沉溺于当下，因为未来总是在变化。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 That's why it is the future. Unexpected things happen every once in a while in the future. Lala~
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这就是未来啊。未来总会时不时发生意想不到的事情。啦啦~

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Hmm... Expecting a lot. Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
嗯...期待很多呢。呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 But isn't it better than a curse. Just think of it as that and forget about it.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
但这总比诅咒好吧。就把它当作那样，然后忘掉它吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You must feel good, getting a word of encouragement from the Skeleton. Lala~
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
得到邪骸战士的鼓励，你一定感觉不错吧。啦啦~

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 I don't know. Maybe it is saying that a scrawny person will do something great in the future?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
我不知道。也许它是在说，一个瘦弱的人未来会做出伟大的事情？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 If you see someone that resembles the Skeleton, help them. 
 Then the Skeleton will think that you helped itself and be happy. What a silly monster. Haha.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
如果你看到长得像邪骸战士的人，请帮帮他们。
那样邪骸战士就会以为你在帮它自己，然后会很开心。真是只傻乎乎的魔物。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Who knows, the key to the future may be lying in the east.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
谁知道呢，通往未来的钥匙也许就在东方。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 The knight wants you to be proud of yourself. 
 It says what you need is pride. Not honor, wealth, or love.. but pride.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
骑士希望你能为自己感到自豪。
它说你需要的是自豪。不是荣誉、财富或爱情...而是自豪。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It is a very good thing. Means a bright and clear future. Hohoho~
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这是非常好的兆头。意味着未来光明且清晰。呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 You must find out for yourself what those clouds mean. Anyways, you must be careful.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你必须自己去弄清楚那些云意味着什么。总之，你要小心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 ..with the attitude of reflecting upon yourself. What do you think? Don't you think you lived too much looking into the future?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
...带着反省自己的态度。你觉得呢？你不觉得你过去太在意未来了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 It is trying to warn something about the future. Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
它似乎在警告关于未来的某事。小心点。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 In your case, it would be wise to grow your sense of humor.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
就你的情况而言，培养一下幽默感会比较明智。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Even the Anubis doesn't think about death, so why should you be thinking about it? Expect a good future young one.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
连安毕斯都不去想死亡，你为什么要去想呢？期待美好的未来吧，年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 What can be better than being ignored by the god of death?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
还有什么比被死神无视更棒的事呢？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 A business looking into the future?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
一门窥探未来的生意？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Make yourself stronger in any form. In the future, you will need it.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
以任何形式让自己变得更强。在未来，你会需要它的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 To become a Lord, you will need colleagues. You should take the Orc Lord's advice!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
要成为领主，你需要伙伴。你应该听听兽人酋长的建议！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Respect his opinion young one. You have nothing to lose.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
尊重他的意见吧，年轻人。你没什么可损失的。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Are you looking forward to it?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你在期待它吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 What do you think? Any assumptions?
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
你怎么看？有什么猜测吗？

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 One thing for sure is that you will be very happy! Congratulations young one!
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
有一件事是确定的，那就是你会非常幸福！恭喜你，年轻人！

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Meaning your future will become a battle between happiness and frustration..
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
这意味着你的未来将成为幸福与挫败之间的战斗...

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Sadness, failure, darkness, loneliness.. you may feel all of these emotions, but they are not fatal. Don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
悲伤、失败、黑暗、孤独...你可能会感受到所有这些情绪，但它们并不致命。别担心。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 So train yourself not to be tempted. 
 Or else you will face frustration or commit a blunder.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
所以要训练自己不被诱惑。
否则你将面临挫败或犯下大错。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Don't get disturbed by the mark of death. It's merely a Joker's joke.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不要被死亡之兆所困扰。那不过是裘卡的一个玩笑。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Don't prepare for the future carelessly. A loose measure is worse than a prepared adventure.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不要漫不经心地为未来做准备。毫无准备比仓促冒险更糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Don't forget that you must think about yorsrelf the most.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
别忘了，你必须最优先考虑自己。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Or else you will really be a simple and honest fool. That may be troublesome.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
否则你真的会成为一个单纯而诚实的傻瓜。那可能会带来麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Hodes do not ponder about life, but their will to live is very strong.
 You can gain a lot simply through the will to hold on to life.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
蚯蚓不会思考人生，但它们求生的意志非常强烈。
仅仅凭借对生命的执着，你就能获得很多。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Be thankful that you are alive. Thankfullness itself should help greatly.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
感恩你还活着。感恩本身就能带来巨大的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Don't think of them too much. A crisis is simply a crisis.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
不要想太多。危机就只是危机而已。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 Finding different sides of oneself is the way to improve. Study about yourself.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
发现自我的不同侧面是进步之道。去研究你自己吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
 If you don't leave your name, he may bear hatred against you for wasting your life. 
 So, to not be cursed, make an effort to leave your name in history.
scripts.translation:
[利梅托拉]
如果你不留下名字，他可能会因为你浪费生命而对你怀恨在心。
所以，为了不被诅咒，努力在历史上留下你的名字吧。

scripts.text:
[Lhimetorra]
